body.name: Rounded proportional top-\(m\) two-batch design
body.construction: Given \(m\in\{2,\ldots,K-1\}\), \(T\), \(s\), \(w\), and \(0<\rho<1\), the design \(\mathsf D_{\rho,w,m}\) assigns the first-batch observations by deterministic largest-remainder rounding of \(T\rho w_i\), retains the set \(J\in\mathcal J_m:=\{J\subseteq\mathcal A:|J|=m\}\) of the \(m\) largest first-batch sample means using arm-index tie breaking, and assigns all remaining observations among \(i\in J\) by deterministic largest-remainder rounding of \((1-\rho)T w_i/W_J\), where \(W_J=\sum_{k\in J}w_k\). It deploys the survivor with the largest aggregate mean from both batches, again using arm-index tie breaking. Write \(r_i(J;\rho)=(1-\rho)w_i/W_J\) for \(i\in J\), \(r_i(J;\rho)=0\) for \(i\notin J\), and \(n_i(J;\rho)=\rho w_i+r_i(J;\rho)\). The original eliminate-one design is the specialization \(\mathsf D_{\rho,w}=\mathsf D_{\rho,w,K-1}\), with \(J=\mathcal A\setminus\{e\}\).
